title: James Madison, Father of America’s Constitution
summary: Жеймс Мэдисоныг яагаад АНУ-ын Үндсэн хуулийн эцэг гэж нэрлэдэг тухай.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.credit: Jill Robbins, Steve Ember, Faith Lapidus, Bryan Lynn · VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: Jill Robbins, Steve Ember and Faith Lapidus reported on this story for VOA Learning English. Bryan Lynn adapted the reports.

questions.prompt: Why is Madison called "the father of the Constitution"?
options: For his work on a strong national government
For serving two terms as president
For leading the army in the Revolutionary War
questions.explain: "his actions in support of a strong national government and federal laws" нь түүнийг "Father of the Constitution" гэж нэрлүүлсэн гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: What did Madison do during the Constitutional Convention?
questions.explain: "Madison took very detailed notes during the Constitutional Convention" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: What does "ratify" mean in this story?
questions.explain: Нийтлэлд "ratify, or vote to approve" гэж тайлбарласан. Өөрөөр хэлбэл санал өгч батлах гэсэн үг.
